summary: BRILLIANT N.E.V. CORP. filed an 8-K reporting a change in control resulted from private stock transfers on June 5, 2026. Former controlling stockholder Guangzhe Su transferred his entire ~52% stake to multiple transferees (including Yan Li, Yang Liu, Fuzhan Su, Jingtao Wu, Chenghua Liu, Ximing He, Guangli Lei) and retained <0.01%. Su resigned as Chairman, CEO and director, with no disagreement stated. The shares remain restricted; no legends were removed. The transfers split ownership widely—largest block being 20.25% held by Fusheng Lei–controlled Meillon Equity. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for new controlling group's strategic direction and potential subsequent filings under Section 16 or Schedule 13D.
